notes.title: The Shedding and Saving Devlog!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710819/b63993bf12d6f1754a2ba8588215c336a0e11988.png[/img]Hello all! Going to try to keep much better track of changes and improvements in future with devlogs. Also going to aim to have a new build up at least once a month, if not more like weekly, starting this month. Had a series of life events like vacation and moving that have gotten us slightly off course, lately, but our small team is going to work hard to get a finished game out next year!

Among more anticipated updates like being able to buy new stores, and new items, we’re also working on some pretty dang epic laundry battles against a few select bosses, so stay tuned...

[h1]Updates[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710819/77f1330a32f812b36535b69e0ff306030df95094.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Shedding animation changed! Should no longer look like crying...hopefully…
[*] Save state! Auto saves at end of day, choice to continue or start new game on title screen. When game gets more complex, we will aim to have something somewhat more complex like save slots
[*] Fullscreen option! In settings, there is now a fullscreen toggle mode
[*] 720p! Default window size now 1280x720p, aka A Normal Screen Size Dimension
[*] Customers now show what percent of their base payment you’ve earned via the new dollar symbol interaction! It’s not easier to tell the effect of giving back clothes with cat hair or making a customer wait for ages. 
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Laundry will no longer disappear if you click on a dropped load of laundry while already holding laundry
[/list]
